answer: One defence is Adjudicated ship captain licence with maritime authority attestation: a licence the authority renews after voyage audits, and the whisper of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. Because a licence the authority renews after voyage audits, a fresh identity starts with nothing: it must earn its standing the slow way, while the raven for an established agent is already paid and proven. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the timber of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
